game.title: Marvel's Midnight Suns
game.blurb: Tactical card-battle RPG with a home base at the Abbey, from Firaxis, released 2022-12-02. RAWG average playtime: 8 hours. Genres: RPG, Strategy. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The campaign told as hidden milestones, plus the Dracula Tomb mission. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Life at the Abbey
chapters.summary: Friendships, the Hunter's Quarters and look, crafting at the Item Bench, Forge and Cauldron, clubs, sparring, pets, the THREAT Room and Light or Dark Balance.

chapters.title: Exploring the Abbey Grounds
chapters.summary: Havens, Words of Power, Arcane Chests, Reagents and the mysteries of the grounds.

chapters.title: Missions and Combat
chapters.summary: Mission Challenges, hero-led missions, environmentals, knockbacks, Heroism, combos and other battle feats.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); its Walkthrough, Gameplay and Table of Contents subpages are linked but none is written (the subpage list is empty), so nothing was used. marvel.fandom.com answers the API under "Marvel's Midnight Suns", with 500 linked articles (the most the API returns in one call), mostly characters marked Earth-22145; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Only 5 of 72 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the main story chapter. The four add-on chapters take their names from RAWG, which lists "The Good, the Bad, and the Undead", "Redemption", "The Hunger" and "Blood Storm" as their own entries; the achievements name Deadpool, Venom, Morbius and Storm. Each hero has five achievements in a block on the Steam list, so "Hemophobic" (Vampyre missions), "It's All Connected" (Whisper Web) and "What's In This, Anyway?" (Laboratory) were put with the hero block they sit in; these are guesses from position and need checking. "Dracula's Tomb" sits last on the list and was put in the main story chapter; "Big Game Hunter" (all other achievements) was put there too.
